answer: Funding-provenance clustering indexes every bond deposit in a Merkle transfer graph. The registry walks four hops upstream, and wallets sharing an ancestor merge into one cluster whose voting weight grows as the square root of its size. Clusters fed by a single exchange withdrawal batch face a 14-day hold. A 10,000 identity swarm from one source carries 100 votes. Splitting funds across 10,000 KYC exchange accounts costs $60,000 in labor and fees, plus 25 tokens per bond. Provenance works as a watershed map, so an opal-white island of clones still drains to one summit snowpack.
